criterion_text: — Partial update, CAS, and incarnation rejection: a patch changing only description preserves title/tags and persists after re-read; explicit null/empty tags clear only their fields. Two writers with the same revision cannot both commit, validation refusal leaves metadata unchanged, and a stale `expected_instance_id` from Session A cannot mutate recreated same-name Session B even if both have revision 0. Tested with deterministic barriers around replacement and concurrent updates, including timeout/readback behavior (never automatically repeat an indeterminate mutation).

verifiers.summary: Partial updates commit atomically under revision and incarnation preconditions

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: a description-only patch preserved title/tags; title+tags replaced without clearing the description; a stale revision and an empty patch were refused; after kill/recreate the old instance token was a conflict and only the successor identity committed

verifiers.summary: The Agent owner is the single atomic patch authority with revision and incarnation fences

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: eight concurrent patches at one revision produced one commit at revision 2; omitted fields were preserved, explicit null and [] cleared only their fields, invalid/empty patches wrote nothing, and a stale instance was a conflict with the successor record intact
